clips.title: The story
paras: At Agamand Mills, Thurman's remains bear witness to the family's failed stand against the Scourge. The once-wealthy mill owner fell to the Plague and now wanders his ruined estate as an undead thrall.

Before the Third War, the Agamands were Tirisfal Glades' wealthiest landowners, with extensive mills and dozens of local workers. When the Scourge swept across Lordaeron, Thurman Agamand and his kin fortified their estate instead of fleeing. Certain their wealth and strong mills could withstand the attack, they persuaded their loyal workers to take up arms beside them. The defense failed. The Agamands and their workers were slaughtered and made mindless servants of the Lich King. Coleman Farthing, a former worker who rose as Forsaken, now demands the destruction of his former masters. He seeks Thurman's remains as proof that the foolish patriarch paid for dooming his household.
